# M3-S7: eject keeps option behavior with Go-facing signatures (T-Sec5).
# The ejected module builds with plain go and prints the same output;
# ejected signatures use plain pointers and rt.Option[T].
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^eject ok: gadget$'
stdout '^options: true true 7 true$'
stdout '^presence: true false 0 1$'
cp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
grep 'func H.*_logos_rt\.Option' out/main.go
grep 'func I.*_logos_rt\.Option' out/main.go
grep 'func None' out/main.go
grep '_logos_rt\.Option' out/main.go
! grep '\*User\?' out/main.go
! grep '\[\]int\?' out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/eject-stdout.txt
cd ..
cd out
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectopt

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type T struct {
	X int
}

func F() *User? {
	return &User{Name: "alice"}
}

type Box struct {
	P *T?
}

func (b *Box) Get() *T? {
	return b.P
}

func H() []int? {
	return nil
}

func PNil() []int? {
	m := map[string][]int{"n": nil}
	return m["n"]
}

func NNone() []int? {
	return nil
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func I() int? {
	return 7
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("eject ok: " + G(&User{Name: "gadget"}))
	fmt.Printf("options: %t %t %d %t\n", F() != nil, len(H() ?? []int{9}) == 1, I() ?? 0, None() == nil)
	fmt.Printf("presence: %t %t %d %d\n", PNil() != nil, NNone() != nil, len(PNil() ?? []int{9}), len(NNone() ?? []int{9}))
}

type A struct{}

func (A) Name() string { return "a" }

type B struct{}

func (B) Name() string { return "b" }

type Choice interface {
	A | B
	Name() string
}

func None() Choice? {
	return nil
}
